_about: Evidence specs, one entry per live row of docs/process/regressions.md (docs/architecture/evidence-loop.md, decision 82). A row is a list of 1-3 probes; or {human: what Zafar listens or looks for} (a 'how' row: only his ear or feel); or {needsDecision: the question for Zafar, probes: [what is built]} (Fable 18: goes to docs/status.md, never to a sheet). Probe: flow (a run.mjs --list id without @L/#), path (fair, mistake, hint, takeback, speed1, or a driver in _drivers), level (a number, or a list: one panel per level), sizes (phones: 844x390 and 800x360; 390x844 is only the rotate card; 915x375 has no sandbox entry and maps to 844x390), profile (Fable 5: fresh = storage cleared, first-time help on; seen = help marked seen; second-play = play once, capture the second play), want (Fable 5: words or {order, people} the driver seeds for, bounded 20 tries, writing the seed back), at (_at), after (what happened just before: bulb, wrong, takeback, peek), capture (_capture), expect (_expect; null = a reviewer judges), webgl (true: rows about glows, tints, gold outlines; the canvas renderer draws no tints), note. Sound rows are split: 'which' (clip, when, order) is a voice capture with an expect; 'how' (does it sound right) is a human entry.

_expect.lexicon: Fable 10: every visible word in the probe's dom text is in the family lexicon (the language engine's words and recorded phrases) or inside a placeholder (grey italic 'to record' tag: a class ending in -rec); no English dictionary (chai, dai, loon are Kutchi); 'Thank you!' is in the lexicon (decision 81). Nothing from the '?' pop-up counts as child-facing
_expect.!<expect>: negation: any expect with a leading ! must be false (e.g. !lexicon after a bulb press: the English flip is showing)
_expect.textMatches:<regex>: the probe's dom text (or, for a voice capture, the words of its timeline joined by spaces) matches the JavaScript regex; (?i) at the start = case-insensitive
_expect.hasWord:<tag>: the text holds a word the family lexicon tags with this (number, side, colour, name, body-part); used so no spec hand-writes Kutchi (rule 4)
_expect.count:<selector><op><n>: the number of visible elements matching the selector at the moment; op is =, <= or >=
_expect.inside:<a>,<b>: every visible a lies inside a visible b (its box, 1 px tolerance)
_expect.noOverlap:<a>,<b>: no visible a box intersects a visible b box
_expect.centredOn:<a>,<b>: a's centre is within 3 px of b's centre on the axis they share (a text line beside an icon: vertical; a glow on an item: both)
_expect.order:<a>,<b>,<c>: with a strip capture: a, b, c first appear in this order over time; otherwise: they sit in this reading order (top to bottom, then left to right)
_expect.sameOrder:<selector>: the texts of the matching elements, in reading order, are said in the same order in the voice timeline (card order = spoken order)
_expect.noClip:<selector>: nothing inside the element is clipped, ellipsised or scrolled: scrollWidth/Height <= clientWidth/Height for it and every descendant, no text-overflow ellipsis, no child box past its edge
_expect.lines:<selector><op><n>: every matching element's text renders on this many lines (line boxes from Range.getClientRects)
_expect.minFont:<selector>>=<px>: the rendered font size of every text node inside is at least px CSS px (TXT-05: 14)
_expect.minSize:<selector>>=<px>: every matching element is at least px CSS px in both width and height (a touch target)
_expect.countsUp:<selector>: over an every: capture, the number in the element's text goes 1, 2, 3 ... (a running tally, never the target first)
_expect.silentAfter:<moment>: in the voice timeline nothing starts, and nothing is still playing, more than 150 ms after the moment (stage-end, results, popup-fold, mute)
_expect.familyOnly: every line in the voice timeline is class family-ok (no device or TTS voice, no browser speechSynthesis call, nothing silent)
_expect.gapMs:<a>,<b><op><n>: milliseconds from moment a to moment b (Lifecycle events, states, voice line starts by clip id) compare with n
_expect.lastsMs:<selector><op><n>: how long the element stays visible from the moment (polled every 100 ms)
_expect.traceAmp:<selector><op><n>: over a trace capture: the largest swing of position (px), scale or opacity (%) of the element; <=1 = still
_expect.tracePeriod:<selector><op><ms>: over a trace capture: the period of the element's repeating motion (a bob, a pulse)
_expect.traceRepeats:<selector><op><n>: over a trace capture: how many times the element appears or the motion repeats (a ghost finger shown again after each pause)
_expect.clipClass:<class>: every line in the voice timeline has this class (family-ok, tts, silent): familyOnly = clipClass:family-ok
_expect.liveInput: the probe's driver tapped the expected thing while a line was playing and the game accepted it before the line ended
_expect.pass: the probe's contract:<n> or cmd: capture reports no break (contract) or exits 0 (cmd)
_expect.times:<moment><op><n>: how many times the moment came while the probe was armed, repeats included (each ghost-finger play is a life:ghost moment: SH-46, MAA-13)

_capture.shot: the whole screen (last resort: only rows about the whole layout)
_capture.crop:<selector>: the element's box plus a 16 px margin (the default)
_capture.zoom2:<selector>: the same crop at 2x device scale (clipping, fringes, ticks, shadows, art resolution)
_capture.strip:<selector>:<n>x<ms>: a filmstrip of n crops, ms apart, from the moment (motion: a bob, a wrap, a fade, a pulse)
_capture.voice: the text timeline of every line from the moment's play: words, clip id, speaker, start, end, stage boundaries, family or device
_capture.dom:<selector>: Fable 10: the element's visible text nodes in reading order, each tagged with its style (grey italic + 'to record' = placeholder) and source (engine sentence, clip id); read, not looked at
_capture.trace:<selector>:<ms>: Fable 8: the element's position, scale and opacity sampled every 50 ms for ms from the moment, as a small table (motion expects decide on it; a strip is for shape)
_capture.ref:<path|css-token|retired-art id>: Fable 12: the reference pasted beside the crop (a source PNG, a colour token swatch, the shared ring, a retired asset)
_capture.contract:<n>: EXTENSION: contract check n over this probe's play, its breaks as text (build/sandbox/lib/contract.mjs: 1 pop-up, 2 moves-on, 3 voice stops at stage end, 4 bubble, 5 badge order, 6 old art, 7 one voice, 8 one highlight, 9 closed card, 10 your turn, 11 background, 12 greyed, 13 stale UI, 14 talk); 'cover' = the player's covered-tap findings
_capture.cmd:<command>: EXTENSION: a repo script's output (run from the repo root, at most 60 s); with expect 'pass' its exit code decides
_capture.<selector>: a CSS selector; 'canvas:<name>' instead names a Phaser display object by texture key prefix (Fable 7: canvas:tawa, canvas:ladle, canvas:karahi, canvas:thali, canvas:chakla, canvas:velan, canvas:rack, canvas:hob, canvas:pan, canvas:pot); 'tool:<id>' a heal game's tool element (S.toolEls[id]); '<selector>@<moment>' the element as it was at another moment of the same play. zoom2 = re-rendered at deviceScaleFactor 2 (Fable 6), never an upscaled crop 'hook:cook.<fn>' / 'hook:heal.<fn>': the boxes a game's own read-only test hook reports (s04-hooks): hook:cook.glowing (the highlighted picture), hook:cook.gauge (where the gauge is drawn), hook:heal.glowing (the glowing tools), hook:heal.dropper and hook:heal.soreEye (the eye game, CLN-62).

_at.request / stage-start / stage-end / resu: Lifecycle events (js/shared/request-popup.js); popup-fold = the request pop-up folds into the sidebar
_at.<state>: a recorder state the flows already record (start, order-card-big, order-card-in-sidebar, kind-<k>, view-<v>, stir-mid, wrong-tap, wrong-choice, wrong-slice, wrong-stir, help-open, bulb-english, hint-glow, hint-nani-says, peek-open, before-takeback, after-takeback, results-badges, results-words, result, day-summary, shop, title, stage-<s>, <s>-point, <s>-belt, <s>-say, wrong-<s>, idle-hint-<s>, peek-<s>, bulb-<s>, heal-<g>-start, heal-<g>-mid, heal-<g>-slip, between-stages, end, pantry-start, yes-no, whos-playing, picker, house)
_at.exp:<key> / phase:<p>: NEW: the first moment __cook.expectation() has this key (knob, lift, dough, samosa, rack, pan, drop, strip, tawa-on, undo, done) or phase (pour, slow)
_at.step:<id>: NEW: a heal game's debug.next() step by its 'what' (dot, knee, hammer, bandage, wipe, pour, fill, drill, drop, give, plaster, wash, wax, pull, pop, picture, eyetest, straighten, eye-cover, hearing)
_at.visible:<selector>: NEW: the first moment the element is visible
_at.only:<selector>: NEW: the moment the game's expectation is a click on that element alone (it is the only thing left)
_at.every:<moment>: each time the moment happens (one capture each): every:placed (an item or step accepted), every:step (a new step or row opens), every:onboard (a first-time help appears), every:bubble, every:request, every:view, every:your-turn (the hand-over to the child), every:stage-start, every:order-card-in-sidebar, every:visible:<sel>, every:step:<id>
_at.<named moment>: NEW named moments (Fable 2: served, fold, pour, fill, hearing-test, ...), each defined in _moments; the driver change that reaches it lands with the spec
_at.life:ghost: s04-hooks: the ghost finger played once (Onboard's kit, Cook's S.ghost, the first conversation's pill: Lifecycle.ghost logs each play; every:life:ghost = each play)

_drivers.find-scene: Find it: the 'Where is it?' game at level 3 (the level that brings the sitting room, data/find.json) through __find.lab; scene-<id> once it has settled, then played to its end
_drivers.force-passme: a story day with every dish played often enough (the save) and Nani's pass-me chance set to 1 in Cook's own data at run time: she asks at her first chance in each station (passme-forced), answered after her ring
_drivers.heal-fast: a morning whose heal game is played with no waits between steps (heal-fast-done when it ends), straight into the send-off
_drivers.idle-twice: at the first move: waits 8 s (idle-hint: the ghost finger), makes no move, waits another 8 s (idle-again), then plays fair; with profile second-play, in the second play
_drivers.lab-log-on: opens the clinic stage with &lab=1 (the lab bar and its log showing: lab-log-on), then plays fair
_drivers.mute-across-modes: Cook on the game host: in the first stage Nani's guide box is muted (muted-in-cook); the clinic (clinic.html, the scrape) opened on the same save, after-mute at its first heal step; back on the game host (after-mute-cook) and the round played to its end
_drivers.serve-combined: a story day played fair, recording the service view of an order of two dishes once both cards are stamped (served-combined): day 2's third order is Nana's maani + chai
_drivers.start-over: plays a round fair, then the title's grown-ups' 'Start over' (started-over), the same station again at the same level, and in it the '?' pop-up's 'Play as new'; after-start-over is the order card then
_drivers.tap-during-pause: while the request pop-up reads the order: in a pause between two of Nani's lines, a tap on the play area (tap-during-pause); then pause-skipped (the pop-up folded) or pause-kept
_drivers.tap-during-speech: taps the first thing asked while a line (Nani's or the doctor's) is being said (waits up to 8 s for one): tap-taken-while-speaking when the game took it before the line ended, tap-held-till-quiet when it waited
_drivers.tap-quick: plays without the '?' round, each count word marked as it starts (count-word), so the gap between them is the game's own pace
_drivers.tap-through-popup: taps the request pop-up 0.25 s after it opens (at test speed it folds by itself within a second; a probe of its card takes it at popup-open), then plays fair
_drivers.tawa-empty-then-off: maani: at the first move, the tawa lit with nothing on it (2 s: tawa-empty), the knob turned high, low, off (2 s: knob-off), on again, then cooks fair. The sizzle loop (synthesized, no file) is logged into the voice timeline as sfx/sizzle-loop
_drivers.turn-early-late: sekelo grill: turns the first skewer before its green (wrong-early), the next after it (wrong-late), then grills fair
_drivers.wrong-count: in the first counted step (a count or 'one more' step) puts one fewer than asked and closes the step (wrong-count), then finishes fair
_drivers.wrong-extra-person: in a 2-person chai (chai-tray L2): the last person's pan, once everything they asked for is in, gets a spice from the shelf they did not ask for (aadu when it is on the shelf); then Done, the redo (wrong-redo) and fair
_drivers.wrong-spice-thrice: daar: a wrong spice in the tadka on three tries (each try the whole tadka: the game takes it out and asks again), wrong-1..3; then the game shows the right way (shown-right)
_drivers.wrong-thrice: three wrong picks in a row at the same step (Cook: the expectation's own wrong items; a heal game: its debug slip(), else another tool than the one asked for), wrong-1..3; then the help and the right way (shown-right)
_drivers.takeback: the clinic's take-back (like Cook's #takeback): the first thing placed is tapped again (a heal game's placement, the pharmacy tray's dish, a waiting-room tick): before-takeback, after-takeback
_drivers.real-pace: the clinic without the lab's fast mode (no &fast=1): its zooms and waits take their real time (CLN-87: 1.5 s), played fair

_tools.build/tools/review/evidence.mjs: the evidence loop itself (--plan --all exits 1 on any live row with no spec: PRC-06); being built in parallel
_tools.build/tools/review/heal-marks.mjs: prints, per heal game and level, the words it marks in ctx.mark (CLN-119) and, with --pool eye, the eye chart's item pool per level (CLN-38); exit 0
